summary.text: Tammy Nuccio represents Connecticut's 53rd House District, which encompasses Tolland, Willington and Vernon, and was first elected in November 2020.

paragraphs.text: She is Ranking Member of the Appropriations Committee and is a former member of the Tolland Town Council.
She is a financial analyst for Cigna with more than 30 years of finance experience, and holds bachelor's and master's degrees in business administration from Bay Path University.
